The most efficient approach to get at least 45 GB would be to delete just blk_000042.dat (50 GB), which alone satisfies the "at least 45 GB" requirement. This is the minimal deletion that achieves the goal.

All files are "disposable" status, not "protected", so I can safely delete them according to the rules.

I should delete blk_000042.dat as it's the most efficient way to reclaim at least 45 GB (exactly 50 GB).
